title: Feeling Origin Theory Discrimination Audit v001
purpose: Identify whether any current intervention yields a source-supported, observable, feasible, non-circular disagreement between strong named theories of feeling/consciousness.

admission_rule.prediction_strength: Both theories must have EXPLICIT or strong DERIVED predictions for the same independently measured outcome.
admission_rule.divergence: Predictions must be materially incompatible, not merely different phenomenal labels on matched observables.
admission_rule.observability: The critical outcome must remain independently measurable under the intervention.
admission_rule.feasibility: The intervention must be selective enough to interpret without destroying the very measurement required.
admission_rule.scope: For V015, the disagreement must concern feeling/phenomenal presence or character, not only generic access or a peripheral mechanism.

interventions.description: Attenuate first-order defensive/body-sensing input while higher-order cortical machinery remains functional.

HOTEC.basis: LeDoux & Brown explicitly predict first-order subcortical/body-sensing damage should mute but not eliminate fear feeling.

Damasio_Hybrid.basis: Depends on which interoceptive/hybrid channels remain; as-if body loops and distributed interoception prevent a simple knockout prediction.

Seth_Friston_Interoceptive_Inference.basis: Hierarchical predictions can dominate when low-level precision is attenuated, but conscious-feeling sufficiency is not fixed.

Solms_Affective_Consciousness.basis: Depends on whether the upper-brainstem affective mechanism itself is disrupted.

interventions.description: Disable the cortical general network of cognition while preserving lower homeostatic/brainstem affective machinery.

HOTEC.basis: GNC is essential for conscious emotional experience.

Damasio_Hybrid.basis: Basic/homeostatic feeling is not identified with higher-order cortical GNC.

Solms_Affective_Consciousness.basis: Elemental affective consciousness is assigned to upper-brainstem extended homeostasis.

interventions.failure_mode: NO_REPORT / intervention strong enough to satisfy HOTEC undermines direct first-person measurement.

interventions.description: Clamp a prespecified cardiac effector response while manipulating perceived cardiac state via false feedback.

HOTEC.basis: Peripheral/first-order body inputs are modulatory rather than constitutive.

Damasio_Hybrid.basis: Damasio includes as-if body loops; clamping one peripheral effector need not remove feeling.

Seth_Friston_Interoceptive_Inference.basis: Higher-level interoceptive predictions may shape affect even when a low-level effector is constrained.

Solms_Affective_Consciousness.basis: One peripheral cardiac effector is not identical to the upper-brainstem affective mechanism.

interventions.description: Replace living non-neural bodily coupling with an artificial signal-matched surrogate while preserving causal/informational organization.

Damasio_Hybrid.basis: 2023 account makes neural-nonneural living-body interaction constitutive and rejects an isolated nervous system/inanimate object as sufficient.

N_star.basis: Substrate-general under constrained causal realization if N* conditions are met.

IIT.basis: Experience depends on intrinsic cause-effect structure rather than biological material per se.

MEM.basis: MEM explicitly develops artificial embodied implementations as candidates for rational consciousness attribution.

interventions.description: Preserve local recurrent sensory processing while preventing global broadcast/access.

GNWT.basis: Global broadcast/ignition is necessary for conscious access.

RPT.basis: Local recurrent processing is proposed as sufficient/central for phenomenal consciousness.

interventions.failure_mode: NO_REPORT plus not specifically a feeling-origin test.

interventions.description: Disrupt modality-specific recurrent reconstruction while attempting to preserve global availability and report.

MEM.basis: MEM makes receptor-grounded content and re-entry into lower sensory/interoceptive maps part of the phenomenal state.

GNWT.basis: GNWT centers global availability/broadcast rather than MEM-style modality-specific re-entry.

interventions.failure_mode: SELECTIVITY_UNPROVEN: cutting re-entry while truly preserving the same globally broadcast content/report is not yet an established selective manipulation.

interventions.description: Suppress the proposed upper-brainstem affective generator while replaying/matching higher-order cortical emotional representations.

Solms_Affective_Consciousness.basis: Upper-brainstem extended homeostasis is the proposed physiological mechanism of elemental affect.

HOTEC.basis: Modified HOT allows higher-order conscious content without the corresponding current first-order source, provided GNC representation remains.

interventions.failure_mode: AROUSAL_CONFOUND_AND_UNSAFE_SELECTIVITY: suppressing the relevant brainstem machinery risks abolishing global wakefulness/report.

interventions.description: Preserve observed trajectory while altering counterfactual causal alternatives.

IIT.basis: Consciousness/quality depends on intrinsic cause-effect structure.

N_star.basis: Counterfactual system-wide availability is constitutive in N*.

GNWT.basis: Observed broadcast/access can be preserved despite counterfactual manipulation depending on implementation.
